items.title: v8.4.176 - `ultralytics 8.4.176` Keep CLIP out of YOLO-World checkpoints after set_classes (328 MB → 26 MB) (#26647)
items.summary: 🌟 Summary YOLO 8.4.176 makes YOLO-World checkpoints much smaller after setting custom classes, while improving reliability across validation, fine-tuning, segmentation, tracking, and model deployment. 📊 Key Changes YOLO-World checkpoints are dramatically smaller: Setting classes no longer caches the CLIP text encoder by default. For yolov8s-worldv2.pt , a saved checkpoint shrank from 328.5 MB to 25.8 MB , with identical predictions after reload. Caching remains available when explicitly request…
